To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 05 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly forecast: quick commit signal + prep for Thu huddle

Team —

Quick note ahead of Thursday's numbers huddle (10:00 PT). We need a concise commit signal for StellarHealth (DEAL-8741) and a crisp pre-call packet for the huddle. The ask:

1) Karthik — status on legal/terms and any outstanding procurement gating items? Can you confirm if the PO timeline shifted?
2) Marissa — updated close probability and expected ARR this quarter (if you can attach the compact MAP).
3) Rishi — any risk flags from finance (billing cadence changes, special pricing approvals needed)?
4) Laura — are there any CS/implementation notes that should influence commit level?

Goal: by Wed 17:00 PT we lock a commit level: commit / best-case / no-commit. We want the huddle to be decision-first — surface blockers only. I attached a one-pager template (precall-notes.pdf) in Drive; please drop a filled MAP or numbers sheet into the Drive folder or attach here.

Agenda for Thu (10:00 PT, 30m):
- 2m: quick context and target
- 8m: account reporter (Marissa) + commit ask
- 10m: legal/procurement & finance quicks (Karthik/Rishi)
- 7m: CS/implementation signoff (Laura)
- 3m: decision + next steps

If any of you think we should escalate to AE + RevOps before locking, flag in your reply.

Thanks — Grace

--
Grace O'Connor

Subject: Re: Weekly forecast: quick commit signal + prep for Thu huddle

Grace —

Short answer: Legal is clear on the core SOW language; procurement pushed back on the standard 60-day PO because StellarHealth needs a procurement approval window tied to their Q3 budget, which may delay internal PO sign-off by ~2 weeks. I expect final terms signoff by 6/19 if no surprises.

No change on commercial redlines that affect revenue recognition. I flagged the extended PO timeline as a gating risk for the huddle; if we want to push for a verbal commit we can, but finance will likely want an ARR recognition plan for a delayed PO.

Will add a one-line summary to the MAP in Drive.

—Karthik
Senior Sales Counsel | Redwood Inference

Team — attaching the compact MAP (StellarHealth_MAP_v2.xlsx) and my executive summary below. I also copied Donna for visibility; she confirmed budget is approved but procurement timing is the blocker (per Karthik).

Executive summary (numbers):
- Current best-case ARR: $420k (starting FY Q3)
- Probability (sales-adjusted): 55% -> proposed commit level for forecast: "best-case"
- Anticipated PO date window: 06/18 - 06/25 (per procurement contact)

Key asks for the huddle:
- Finance: guidance on whether we mark as commit with PO-window note or keep as best-case until PO received.
- Legal/Sales: approve verbal commit playbook (i.e., accept a revops-noted verbal commit with explicit PO window).
- CS: confirm implementation readiness if we accelerate onboarding in July.

Attached: StellarHealth_MAP_v2.xlsx (compact mapping of contacts, milestones, and required approvals). I dropped a one-page precall-notes.pdf in the shared drive with a filled-in summary.

Thanks — Marissa

Perfect — thanks Marissa and Karthik.

Final prep notes before Thu:
- We will present StellarHealth as "best-case / commit contingent on PO by 6/25". RevOps, please tag the deal with PO-window metadata so downstream reporting captures the nuance.
- Rishi: please bring a short note on recognition treatment if PO slips into next quarter. Two bullets only.
- Laura: have CS confirm the 3-week onboarding window and any premium services required for July start.
- Marissa: please have the MAP in Drive and attach the compact spreadsheet to the huddle invite so execs can open quickly.

Agenda remains 30m. If Donna (StellarHealth) wants to join the huddle for the decision call we can pull her into the last 10 minutes — Marissa, confirm with her availability; otherwise we will run internally and update her immediately after.

See you Thu 10:00 PT.

Grace
